name: list_accounts
description: List all configured mailbox accounts on this connector. Returns id, label, default flag, From-address and CalDAV-enabled flag — never credentials. Use the `id` value as the `account` parameter on other tools.

name: list_folders
description: List all IMAP mailboxes (folders) on the configured account. Returns path, name, flags and special-use attribute (e.g. \Sent, \Drafts, \Trash) — useful for picking the right `mailbox` parameter for other tools.

account.description: Account ID (from list_accounts) to act on. Omit to use the default account.

name: list_messages
description: List the newest messages in a mailbox (newest first). Returns headers + a short preview, NOT the full body — use get_message for the body.

account.description: Account ID (from list_accounts) to act on. Omit to use the default account.

name: search_messages
description: Server-side IMAP SEARCH across one mailbox. Combine any criteria (AND-style). Dates must be ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Returns headers + short preview — use get_message for the body.

mailbox.description: IMAP folder path to search in

body.description: Substring match in the message body

before.description: Match messages strictly before this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

unread.description: true = unread only, false = read only

flagged.description: true = flagged only, false = unflagged only

account.description: Account ID (from list_accounts) to act on. Omit to use the default account.

name: get_message
description: Fetch one message by UID. Returns headers, full text+HTML body, attachment metadata (filenames + content types, NOT raw bytes), and threading IDs (Message-ID, In-Reply-To, References) for replies.

mailbox.description: IMAP folder the message lives in

uid.description: Message UID as returned by list_messages/search_messages

account.description: Account ID (from list_accounts) to act on. Omit to use the default account.

name: send_message
description: Send an email via SMTP. WRITE OPERATION — the message goes out immediately. Use create_draft instead if you want to review before sending. Saves a copy in the Sent folder if configured. For replies, pass in_reply_to + references from the original get_message result.

to.description: Recipient(s). String or array of email addresses.

account.description: Account ID (from list_accounts) to act on. Omit to use the default account.

name: create_draft
description: Build an RFC-822 message and APPEND it to the Drafts folder. Does NOT send. Use for compose-and-review flows where the user wants to edit in their mail client before sending.

account.description: Account ID (from list_accounts) to act on. Omit to use the default account.

name: mark_read
description: Set or clear the \Seen flag on a message. WRITE OPERATION but easily reversible.

read.description: true = mark as read, false = mark unread

account.description: Account ID (from list_accounts) to act on. Omit to use the default account.

name: move_message
description: Move a message from one mailbox to another (e.g. Inbox → Archive). WRITE OPERATION.

account.description: Account ID (from list_accounts) to act on. Omit to use the default account.

name: delete_message
description: Delete a message. DESTRUCTIVE — most IMAP servers move it to Trash but some EXPUNGE immediately. Prefer move_message to a Trash folder for reversibility.

account.description: Account ID (from list_accounts) to act on. Omit to use the default account.

name: list_calendars
description: List all CalDAV calendars on the configured account. Returns URL (used as `calendar_url` in other tools), display name, timezone, and supported components. Errors if the resolved account has no CalDAV configured.

account.description: Account ID (from list_accounts) to act on. Omit to use the default account.

name: list_events
description: List events in a calendar between two timestamps. Recurring events are expanded into individual instances.

calendar_url.description: Calendar URL as returned by list_calendars

account.description: Account ID (from list_accounts) to act on. Omit to use the default account.

name: create_event
description: Create a new calendar event. WRITE OPERATION. Use all_day=true for date-only events (start/end should then be YYYY-MM-DD; end is exclusive — for a one-day event set end to the day after).

calendar_url.description: Calendar URL as returned by list_calendars

start.description: ISO 8601 datetime with timezone offset, e.g. 2026-05-22T09:00:00+02:00

attendees.description: Email addresses of attendees. Note: CalDAV does NOT send invitations on its own — most servers expect the client to mail the iMIP invite separately.

account.description: Account ID (from list_accounts) to act on. Omit to use the default account.

name: find_free_slot
description: Find free time slots across one or more calendars in a window. Returns continuous gaps long enough to fit `duration_minutes`. Optional working hours restrict the search to a daily window (in UTC; pass start/end already in your local TZ if you want local-time anchoring).

calendar_urls.description: One or more calendar URLs to consider busy

range_start.description: ISO 8601 datetime with timezone offset, e.g. 2026-05-22T09:00:00+02:00

working_hours.description: Restrict slots to this daily UTC window (e.g. 8–18 for 09:00–19:00 in CEST)

account.description: Account ID (from list_accounts) to act on. Omit to use the default account.
